popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Phoenician stemma — Telephassa as wife of Agenor and mother of Europa and Cadmus, the hinge between the eastern court and Thebes' foundation.

popCulture.title: Europa (consort of Zeus)
popCulture.description: Europa's abduction from Tyre begins the search that empties Agenor's house — Telephassa the mother who follows Cadmus westward until she dies in Thrace.

popCulture.title: Cadmus
popCulture.description: Cadmus' long wandering for Europa is also Telephassa's journey — the Phoenician queen who dies before her son founds Thebes.

popCulture.title: Telephassa
popCulture.description: Phoenician queen, mother of Europa and Cadmus — the parent who leaves Tyre in the search that seeds Theban myth.
